answer.why: Both Tetra Tech and Jacobs Solutions are global professional engineering and consulting services firms. Tetra Tech is described as a "Global provider of high-end technical and engineering services" focused on "water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure" [T:P1.1, T:P2.7], delivering integrated engineering and scientific services throughout the project lifecycle [T:P2.5]. Jacobs is likewise described as a "global professional services company delivering engineering, design, consulting and infrastructure solutions" [C:P1.2] covering water infrastructure [C:P1.17], flood risk management [C:P1.8], and environmental challenges [C:P1.5]. Both serve government agencies and commercial clients, both are project-based service providers, and both operate globally. The core service offering (engineering consulting, design, program management) and the core customer base (public agencies and commercial clients in water/environment/infrastructure) are the same. Jacobs has some additional exposure in advanced manufacturing/life sciences [C:P1.3] and SaaS-style digital twins [C:P1.25], but these are supplementary to what is otherwise a strongly overlapping business — they do not break the direct-peer relationship.
